thread:
maria (eng-runtime): heads up — starting ~1802468000 we saw continuous growth in KV cache for rope-ntk longctx prefetch keys, memory climbed and tail latency spiked. paging oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-20280312-ntk-prefetch-kv. Pager notified: @alex oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-blowup

raj (eng-sre): seeing the same in metrics dashboard — heap for rope nodes increased 2.6x, eviction not keeping up, kv-cardinality exploded. QPS stable, but per-token latency jumped from 80ms to 450ms.

alex (oncall): joining. any recent deploys or config flips?

maria (eng-runtime): we flipped `rope.prefetch.enabled=true` for NTK longctx sliding-window yesterday to improve cold-starts. suspect prefetch + continuous-batching/pinning causing thundering writes to kv.

alex (oncall): can you confirm flags? `curl -s https://config.redwood/api/flags/rope.prefetch` shows `true`?

maria (eng-runtime): confirmed. Also saw many new keys with pattern `rope-ntk:user:<uid>:prefetch:<seq>` in KV dashboard.

raj (eng-sre): first mitigation: roll the flag back to false for NTK customer pool. who can flip? @taylor?

taylor (eng-ml): I can do it. Will flip prefetch at config layer then restart a few frontends. Doing `PATCH /config/flags` now...

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step executed: reduced prefetch for pool ntk-longctx, action id run-1802468025.

alex (oncall): flipping in prod now. command: ```
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"rope.prefetch.enabled","value":false,"scope":"pool:ntk-longctx"}' \
  https://config.redwood/api/flags
```

maria (eng-runtime): once flag flips, we should also reduce continuous_batch.max_tokens from 4096 -> 1024 temporarily to ease KV write batching pressure. can someone patch that?

raj (eng-sre): applying batch cap change via infra config. patching autoscaler/batching policy: `continuous_batch.max_tokens=1024` for ntk pool.

alex (oncall): also evict hot prefix keys to free immediate memory: `rbctl kv evict --prefix rope-ntk:user:` — who has permission?

maria (eng-runtime): I do. Running now. `rbctl kv evict --prefix rope-ntk:user: --dry-run` then actual.

maria (eng-runtime): evict started. progress shows ~78k keys removed so far.

lei (customer-support): heard from two customers about increased latency on large-context chat. apologizing and clarifying we are investigating; logged incidents CS-1422 and CS-1423. No data loss reported.

alex (oncall): after flag flip + evict + batch cap change: metrics show memory plateauing, p50 latency falling back to ~120ms, p99 still elevated at ~620ms. Good sign. Keep watching for 15m.

raj (eng-sre): adding temporary autoscale: spin up 3 extra rope workers in us-west-2 to handle ongoing KV thaw. `orchestrator scale --pool ntk-longctx --add 3` done.

ops-runbook-bot: Autoscale action executed (orchestrator run id scale-1802468100).

maria (eng-runtime): noticed a secondary problem — sliding-window prefetch had created duplicated entries because of inflight sequence merges under continuous batching. We'll need a code fix in runtime to dedupe prefetch requests before kv writes. open ticket: ENG-3521.

alex (oncall): handoff note: I'm staying on the pager for next hour; if metrics stabilize, we'll call mitigation successful and mark as resolved. @taylor, @maria, @raj — any followups you want on handoff?

taylor (eng-ml): will schedule a canary of prefetch=false + batch cap change on staging and a small controlled re-enable test with better rate-limiting. Also prepping a quick test to reproduce thundering prefills.

raj (eng-sre): next steps: monitor KV cardinality, tail latency, and eviction throughput. If we see any re-rise, fallback to routing new requests to ntk-shortctx variant (context 2048) as emergency fallback.

lei (customer-support): telling impacted customers we're actively mitigating; ETA unknown, offering credits if SLA breached.

alex (oncall): 20m check: p50=95ms, p95=210ms, p99=480ms. memory trending down. I'm going to set `incident: triaged` and handoff to maria for postmortem. @maria can you take primary?

maria (eng-runtime): taking primary for post-incident followup. will own ENG-3521 and a runbook update to explicitly warn about prefetch+continuous-batching interactions.

ops-runbook-bot: Incident status updated to TRIAGED by alex.

raj (eng-sre): leaving a note for root cause analysis: likely chain: sliding-window prefetch enabled -> continuous-batching increased write concurrency -> duplicate prefetch writes under sequence merges -> KV key cardinality blowout -> eviction couldn't keep up -> memory + latency spike.

maria (eng-runtime): action items: 1) immediate: runbook update + rollback knobs (done), 2) medium: implement prefetch dedupe and prefetch rate-limiter (ENG-3521), 3) long: improve KV cardinality monitoring and auto-throttle when write rate exceeds threshold (ENG-3522).

alex (oncall): final: pager cleared for now. leaving annotation: `pager:resolved-by-mitigation` at 1802468389. Anyone else to notify?

lei (customer-support): I'll update customers and close CS tickets after confirm stable for 2 hours.

maria (eng-runtime): I'll draft a short postmortem and schedule blameless RCA tomorrow. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

ops-runbook-bot: Incident INCIDENT-20280312-ntk-prefetch-kv moved to POSTMORTEM_PENDING.
